newsitem.title: USA: National Home to buy some C.J. Home assets.
newsitem.headline: National Home to buy some C.J. Home assets.

text.p: National Home Health Care Corp said on Thursday it entered into an agreement to buy certain assets of C.J. Home Care Inc, d/b/a/ Garden City Home Care, a New York state licensed home health care agency.
Garden City Home Care provides home health aide services in Nassau County, N.Y. and had annual revenues of about $2 million in the most recent fiscal year, the company said.
Garden City Home Care would strengthen the company's existing market share in Nassau County, National Home Health Care said. The deal was expected to close late in the first quarter of 1997, it said.
